info.title: qPapel Protection Web API
info.description: qPapel Protection API provides developer-grade license validation, remote software configuration, staff URL delegation, client anti-cheat heuristics, and Discord community integration for desktop applications and loaders.

tags.name: License Keys
tags.description: Programmatic management of customer license keys, hardware ID bindings, activations, and bans.

tags.name: Reseller Keys
tags.description: Multi-seat reseller key creation, extension, duration freeze, and license allocation.

tags.name: Remote Settings
tags.description: Secure remote runtime configuration mapping, build SHA-256 verification, and dynamic values.

tags.name: Staff Management
tags.description: Temporary and scope-limited web portal URLs for support moderators.

tags.name: Discord Integrations
tags.description: Guild linkage, anti-cheat event channel streaming, and role-based bot permissions.

tags.name: Client Security & Anti-Cheat
tags.description: Device fingerprint monitoring, process blacklists, window title filters, and server-side protected strings/files.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated and filterable list of active, expired, or banned license keys.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope filter for key ownership: 'me' (own keys), 'resellers', or 'all'.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Filter keys by specific product cheat_value or product ID.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search string matching license key sequence or user notes.

parameters.name: expiresInDays
parameters.description: Filter keys scheduled to expire within the specified number of days.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field name to sort results by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort ordering direction.

post.description: Generate a new license key with custom duration, HWID binding rules, activation modes, and optional metadata notes.

product_id.description: Unique numeric database ID of the target product.

days.description: Validity duration in days (or hours if key_type is hour_limited).

note.description: Internal reference notes or customer identifier.

max_uses.description: Maximum activations allowed before key locks out.

bind_hwid.description: Enforce hardware ID locking on first machine activation.

auto_start.description: If true, expiry countdown begins upon generation rather than on first client use.

amount.description: Quantity of keys to generate in bulk (max 100).

delete.description: Permanently remove a license key from the system.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique database ID of the license key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique database ID of the license key.

days.description: Number of days to append to the license end date.
